youtube.title: Diogenes carried a lamp at NOON to find one honest man 🔦 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Diogenes walked through Athens in broad daylight with a lamp… looking for ONE honest man. 🔦

Plato volunteered. It did not go well.

Comment the reply YOU would've sent Diogenes 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Diogenes Laërtius: Diogenes of Sinope, the Cynic philosopher ("Diogenes the Dog"), lit a lamp in daytime and walked around saying "I am looking for a human being."

#diogenes #philosophy #ancientgreece #greekphilosophy #historymemes #funnyhistory #shorts
